meta.note: All experiments are deterministic. The paired drift corpora are regenerated from string seeds; the bootstrap seeds are recorded.

design.note: Synthetic persona retrieval, not human authorship. The profile is fixed between conditions; only the query window moves across the recorded drift point. Template reusers are a placebo: they have no drift, so any pre/post change there is corpus noise.

Seeds vary identifiers and corpora, not the planted collision graph: every seed plants the same classes of widespread and coincidental defaults. The correlation counts are therefore expected to be identical across seeds, and a zero SD here means the result is structural rather than a lucky draw. The topology sweep is the experiment that varies the structure.
services_per_cluster also sets the frequency cap, so this is a test of the derivation, not only of scale.
None is the naive correlator. The derived cap is max(2, services_per_cluster); it is not selected by looking at these rows.

The query is the unit. Top-1 correctness is matched per service. Non-mate candidates are counted per query (directed: the wrong names one query would surface) and again as distinct unordered pairs, which is the unit `score_links` uses.
